meta.title: Live Trading Setup Guide
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create a comprehensive live trading setup guide for users to configure rustybt for live trading on all supported platforms.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Setup guide covers all supported platforms: Binance, Bybit, Hyperliquid, Lighter.xyz, Interactive Brokers
Step-by-step instructions: account creation, API key generation, environment variables, testnet/mainnet config
Security best practices: API key permissions, environment variables, encrypted keystores, IP whitelisting
Troubleshooting section: connection errors, authentication failures, rate limits, order rejections

architecture-context.constraint: Never log API keys or private keys (NFR13)
Credentials from environment variables or secure config (NFR14)

technical-specifications.spec: # Live Trading Setup Guide ## Overview ## Prerequisites ## Platform Setup ### Binance ### Bybit ### Hyperliquid ### Lighter.xyz ### Interactive Brokers ## Security Best Practices ### API Key Permissions ### Environment Variables ### Encrypted Keystores ### IP Whitelisting ## Configuration File ## Troubleshooting ## Next Steps

## Security Best Practices ### Environment Variables (Recommended) ```bash # Testnet (safe for testing) export BINANCE_TESTNET_API_KEY="your_testnet_api_key" export BINANCE_TESTNET_SECRET="your_testnet_secret" ``` ### Minimum API Permissions - Trading: Enable for order submission - Read: Enable for position/balance queries - **Withdrawal: NEVER enable**

nfr-references.nfr: Never log API keys or private keys
